# telnyx_network_default_gateway (Resource)

The default gateway of a network: the WireGuard peer that traffic without a more specific route leaves through. There is one per network, identified by the network id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send traffic without a more specific route through the laptop peer.
resource "telnyx_network_default_gateway" "office" {
  network_id        = telnyx_network.office.id
  wireguard_peer_id = telnyx_wireguard_peer.laptop.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) Network ID.

### Optional

- `wireguard_peer_id` (String) Wireguard peer ID.

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `status` (String) The current status of the interface deployment.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_network_default_gateway.example <network_id>
```
